passage:
F1: I’m Nia from the event crew. Are the radios ready? I can carry them to the stewards if someone can sign for them here.
M: I’m the storeroom clerk. I can’t sign them out to myself. Could your crew leader come to the desk? I don’t want to leave a full case on the unattended side counter.
F2: I’m Leila, the crew leader. I’ll sign before Nia takes the case. Can you leave one spare battery here? The late crew can pick it up from you.
F1: That works. I’ll take the case straight to the stewards after you’ve signed.

title: Questions 41–43

Number 43. What does Leila ask the clerk to set aside?
